The Resample Library Spectra tool resamples input library spectra to match the number of bands and wavelength range of target spectra from a target sensor, custom spectral library file, or custom image.

The file containing the spectra that will be resampled. The input library spectra must be an Esri spectral library file (.esl).

The target sensor, custom spectral library file, or custom image that contains the target spectra.

The spectral library file (.esl) or image that contains the target spectra. If you use an image for the target spectra, it must contain wavelength information.

The resampling method used to resample the input spectral library file.

The name of the Esri spectral library file (.esl) created.

The type of output that will be created. The output can be a tiled imagery layer or a dynamic imagery layer.

The name of the folder in My content where the result will be saved.
